analyses.current_state: Customers can update their registered email address through the profile management page. The updated email address is validated and synchronized with the CRM system.
analyses.proposed_change: Customers should also be able to update their registered mobile phone number through the profile management page.
analyses.business_context: The application integrates with CRM, Identity Management, Notification Service and Customer Data Platform.

executive_summary.change_overview: Extending customer self-service profile management to support mobile phone number updates, transitioning beyond single-attribute email updates to multi-factor verified contact data.
executive_summary.overall_impact: The proposed change has a High Impact (72/100) because it introduces personally identifiable customer data (PII), multi-factor SMS verification workflows, stringent security anti-takeover controls, and bi-directional synchronization across downstream CRM and CDP systems.
key_areas_affected: OTP SMS Verification & Rate Limiting Services
top_risks: Account takeover via unauthorized SIM/number reassignment without secondary verification
Desynchronization or race conditions between CRM and Customer Database during concurrent profile updates
SMS delivery latency or gateway outage blocking critical profile update workflows
executive_summary.recommended_next_step: Conduct a cross-functional stakeholder impact workshop involving Product, Solution Architecture, Security (InfoSec), and CRM Integration teams to baseline OTP verification policies and uniqueness constraints before finalizing functional specifications.

impact_areas.description: Extends profile management feature to capture, validate, verify, and store international mobile numbers.
impact_areas.reason: The proposed change introduces new mobile number input mask, country code selection, OTP submission modals, and multi-state error handling.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Draft explicit functional specifications for mobile number formats (E.164), OTP retry policies, cooldown limits, and edge case flows (duplicate numbers, unreachable devices).

impact_areas.description: New business rules governing mobile uniqueness, change frequencies, and account linkage.
impact_areas.reason: Decisions required on whether mobile numbers can be shared across family accounts, maximum update attempts per 24 hours, and cooling-off periods.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Formalize business rules: mandate uniqueness per customer account, enforce a 24-hour sensitive transaction cooldown following number changes, and require dual confirmation.

impact_areas.description: Profile edit modal changes, OTP entry timer, and status feedback widgets.
impact_areas.reason: UI requires international dial code dropdown, real-time input formatting, a 6-digit OTP modal with resend countdown timer, and accessible validation states.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Create Figma prototypes for desktop and mobile web viewports; ensure WCAG AA compliance for screen reader notifications on OTP countdown expiration.

impact_areas.description: Schema updates in customer entity table and audit log tables.
impact_areas.reason: Database requires storing normalized E.164 phone numbers, country code, verification status timestamp, and immutable audit history for compliance.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Add `phone_number`, `phone_country_code`, `phone_verified_at` columns with appropriate indexes, unique constraints, and schema migration scripts.

impact_areas.description: Customer Profile API contract extension and new OTP generation/validation endpoints.
impact_areas.reason: API v2 payloads must accept phone attributes and handle new error response codes (e.g. 409 Conflict, 429 Rate Limit Exceeded).
impact_areas.recommended_action: Update OpenAPI / Swagger specifications for `PATCH /api/v1/customer/profile` and add endpoints `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/send` and `POST /api/v1/auth/otp/verify`.

impact_areas.description: Real-time or event-driven integration with CRM, CDP, and SMS Gateway providers.
impact_areas.reason: Mobile updates must publish events to Kafka/SQS for downstream CRM ingestion, CDP identity resolution, and SMS dispatch.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Define enterprise message schema for `CustomerContactUpdated` event; establish idempotency keys and dead-letter queues (DLQ) for failed syncs.

impact_areas.description: Heightened risk of account takeover, SIM-swap vulnerability, and data privacy (GDPR / TCPA) compliance.
impact_areas.reason: Mobile numbers are PII and often serve as second-factor authentication targets. Unverified updates could compromise user accounts.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Enforce Step-Up Authentication (verify existing email or password) before initiating phone change; send security alerts to both old email and new phone.

impact_areas.description: Customer Support and manual identity verification escalation paths.
impact_areas.reason: Customers who lose access to their registered phone number or enter incorrect details will contact support.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Update Customer Support Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) with an identity-proofing protocol for manual contact info updates.

impact_areas.description: Tracking profile completion rates, OTP delivery success rates, and SMS costs.
impact_areas.reason: Business intelligence and product teams need telemetry on verification drop-offs and SMS unit costs.

impact_areas.description: Comprehensive functional test matrix across international formats and network latency scenarios.
impact_areas.reason: Need automated test coverage for valid/invalid phone numbers, expired OTPs, brute-force OTP attempts, and network dropouts.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Develop Cypress/Playwright E2E suites and integration mock suites for SMS vendor failure simulations.

impact_areas.description: Verification of existing email update flows, login sessions, and downstream CRM webhooks.
impact_areas.reason: Shared profile update controller code could introduce regressions to existing email update or password reset pipelines.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Execute full regression suite across user authentication, email modification, customer checkout, and notification preferences.

impact_areas.description: Updates to Functional Requirements Document (FRD), API guides, and Help Center articles.
impact_areas.reason: Customer-facing FAQs and internal technical architecture documentation must reflect the new capabilities.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Update internal Confluence system architecture maps, Swagger docs, and publish user-facing Help Center guide: "How to update your phone number".

impact_areas.description: Potential scope creep due to third-party SMS vendor onboarding and regulatory compliance reviews.
impact_areas.reason: Integrating a reliable global SMS aggregator (e.g. Twilio/Infobip) may require vendor legal reviews and budget sign-off.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Account for 2-week buffer in sprint plan for SMS aggregator contract setup, security review, and carrier 10DLC compliance verification.

impact_areas.description: Monitoring SMS deliverability, gateway throttling, and telco error codes.
impact_areas.reason: Telco carrier filtering, invalid numbers, and routing failures require real-time alerts.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Configure Prometheus/PagerDuty alert thresholds for OTP failure rate > 5% and SMS gateway response time > 3000ms.

dependencies.dependency_name: OTP SMS Verification Service (e.g., Twilio/AWS SNS)
dependencies.description: Provides programmatic SMS dispatch and token verification with global telco routing.
dependencies.investigation_required: Check vendor SLA, global deliverability rates, per-message cost modeling, and rate limit quotas.

dependencies.description: Downstream repository for customer relationship records and marketing outreach.
dependencies.investigation_required: Verify if CRM schema permits duplicate phone numbers and whether CRM webhook triggers outbound sales workflows.

dependencies.description: Unifies customer identities across omni-channel touchpoints.
dependencies.investigation_required: Determine identity stitch rules: will updating phone number merge or detach anonymous web visitor profiles?

dependencies.description: Manages user sessions, JWT claims, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) credentials.
dependencies.investigation_required: Check if phone number is used as an SMS MFA factor and if updating it requires re-enrolling MFA.

dependencies.description: Legal standards governing automated transactional vs marketing SMS consents.
dependencies.investigation_required: Confirm opt-in consent checkboxes and explicit disclaimer wording required during phone registration.

risks.title: Account Takeover via Weak Verification
risks.description: An attacker with temporary session access updates the victim phone number to their own device, locking out the legitimate user and hijacking MFA.
risks.mitigation: Require re-entering current password or validating an email confirmation token before applying the new mobile number. Send instant alerts to the existing email.

risks.title: Desynchronization Between Database and Downstream CRM
risks.description: Network timeout during CRM API sync causes database to record updated number while CRM retains stale contact info.
risks.mitigation: Implement asynchronous message queue (e.g. SQS/RabbitMQ) with exponential retry, idempotency keys, and automated reconciliation cron jobs.

risks.title: SMS Toll Fraud / OTP Telephony Pumping
risks.description: Malicious actors script automated requests to premium-rate international numbers, racking up thousands of dollars in telecom fees.
risks.mitigation: Implement IP-based rate limiting, Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection, geo-blocking non-serviced countries, and max 3 OTP requests per phone per hour.

risks.title: Duplicate Phone Number Collisions
risks.description: Two different users attempt to register the exact same mobile number, causing primary key conflicts or cross-account data leakage.
risks.mitigation: Apply unique database index on normalized E.164 phone string and enforce clear error feedback prompt: "This mobile number is already linked to another account."

risks.title: SMS Carrier Delivery Lag or Country Restrictions
risks.description: International users experience delays up to 10 minutes or outright carrier filtering of alphanumeric sender IDs.
risks.mitigation: Configure secondary fallback SMS aggregator; allow fallback to email verification or voice OTP for high-latency regions.

Account takeover threat modeling, MFA integrity, and SMS toll fraud prevention posture.
Oversees distributed data consistency, message queue decoupling, and third-party SMS vendor architecture.
Manages downstream CRM payload schemas, ETL synchronization jobs, and CDP identity stitching.
Must construct virtual SMS testing stubs, international validation suites, and cross-browser regression runs.
Ensures adherence to TCPA, GDPR Article 6, and anti-spam opt-in regulations regarding phone communication.
Handles frontline customer tickets when users lose SIM cards or fail OTP verification.

regression_areas.reason: Ensures changes to profile controller and form state do not break existing email modification logic.
Validates that updating mobile numbers does not corrupt login tokens, active sessions, or MFA routing.
Confirms existing CRM contact sync continues operating without dropped records or malformed payloads.
Verifies downstream services that pull customer contact details for shipment tracking receive valid numbers.
Verifies recovery methods continue functioning and do not default to unverified phone numbers.

documentation_impacts.impact_description: Detail E.164 formatting, OTP verification rules, rate limits, and error state matrices.
Document new phone fields on profile endpoints and add OTP generation/verification API specs.
Record new database columns (`phone_number`, `phone_country_code`, `phone_verified_at`) and CRM mapping.
Write support guide for manual customer phone updates and troubleshooting OTP delivery issues.

documentation_impacts.document_type: Security Threat Model & Privacy Impact Assessment
documentation_impacts.impact_description: Document SIM-swap defense mechanisms and GDPR/TCPA compliance audit trail specifications.

open_questions.question: Should mobile number updates require real-time OTP verification before saving to the database?
What is the system behavior if the mobile number is already registered to another active customer?
Should existing logged-in sessions on other devices be terminated when a phone number is updated?
How should the system handle downstream CRM synchronization failures (retry queue vs instant rollback)?
Are there specific international country codes that should be restricted due to high SMS fraud risk?
Should a confirmation email notification be triggered to the original email address alerting them of the change?
What is the maximum number of OTP resend attempts permitted within a 15-minute window?

before_implementation.task: Confirm business rules on duplicate phone number handling with Product & Legal
Define E.164 phone formatting and validation library requirements (e.g. libphonenumber)
Review security implications of account takeover and draft step-up authentication flow
Finalize SMS gateway vendor selection, rate limits, and international cost projections
Align CRM and CDP data schemas with downstream engineering owners

during_development.task: Update database schema with phone fields and unique constraints
Implement OTP dispatch and verification endpoints with rate limiting & cooldown timer
Build responsive UI modal with country code selector, formatted input, and countdown timer
Implement asynchronous message queue for CRM/CDP synchronization with exponential backoff
Add security alerting to notify user of phone change via registered email

before_release.task: Execute end-to-end regression testing across email update, login, and checkout flows
Perform penetration testing and rate-limit stress test on OTP endpoints
Verify downstream CRM data reconciliation across staging environment
Publish updated Help Center documentation and train Customer Support leads
Set up real-time Datadog alerts for SMS delivery failures and error spikes

additional_considerations.description: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) mandates explicit consent before sending automated SMS messages in North America, with penalties up to $1,500 per violation.
additional_considerations.recommended_action: Ensure transactional OTP disclaimers are strictly separated from marketing SMS opt-in checkboxes during phone submission.

additional_considerations.description: Re-cycled phone numbers: Telecom operators routinely reassign disconnected numbers to new subscribers after 90 days.
additional_considerations.recommended_action: Incorporate mobile network operator (MNO) subscriber status checks or verify age of SIM assignment via carrier lookups if high-value transactions are involved.

analyses.project_name: Payment Gateway Migration to Stored Credentials (SCA & 3DS 2.0)
analyses.current_state: Customers enter payment card details on checkout page for one-time payments processed through Legacy Gateway A with synchronous HTTP redirection.
analyses.proposed_change: Upgrade checkout to support tokenized Card-on-File stored credentials and Stripe 3D Secure 2.0 Strong Customer Authentication (SCA).
analyses.business_context: Subscription billing system, multi-region European and US e-commerce store with PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance requirements.

executive_summary.change_overview: Overhaul of payment infrastructure to support PCI-compliant tokenized cards, zero-friction 3D Secure 2.0 Strong Customer Authentication (SCA), and recurring subscription billing.
executive_summary.overall_impact: Critical Impact (84/100) due to strict PCI-DSS regulatory compliance, financial liability shift, async payment challenge webhooks, and direct exposure to customer checkout conversion rates.
key_areas_affected: Async Payment Webhooks & Idempotent Order Creation
top_risks: Drop in mobile checkout conversion rate due to unhandled 3DS challenge timeouts
Double-charging or missed subscription renewals if webhook processing fails or is non-idempotent
PCI compliance breach if unencrypted card data inadvertently touches application servers
executive_summary.recommended_next_step: Schedule an Architecture and Security Review with the Payment Gateway integration architects to validate hosted iframe tokenization (Stripe Elements) and webhook idempotency before code branch kickoff.

impact_areas.description: Support saving cards for future use, handling frictionless vs challenge authentication, and default payment method selection.
impact_areas.reason: Introduces multi-step asynchronous payment intents, dynamic 3DS authentication popups, and card lifecycle management.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Define requirements for card management dashboard (delete, set default, update expiration) and SCA error resolution.

impact_areas.description: Strict adherence to PCI-DSS SAQ-A criteria and PSD2 SCA European mandates.
impact_areas.reason: Handling card tokens requires ensuring no PAN (Primary Account Number) or CVV ever touches internal servers.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Utilize client-side iframe tokenization SDKs to maintain minimal SAQ-A compliance scope.

impact_areas.description: New Payment Intents API, Setup Intents API, and secure Webhook receivers.
impact_areas.reason: Replaces synchronous payment capture with 2-stage authorize/capture and async webhook status callbacks.
impact_areas.recommended_action: Implement signed webhook listener `POST /api/webhooks/stripe` with cryptographic signature verification.

dependencies.description: Processes tokenization, card issuer bank challenges, and SCA liability verification.
dependencies.investigation_required: Verify bank support for biometric 3DS2 frictionless flows and timeout recovery fallback.

dependencies.description: Triggers off-session merchant-initiated transactions (MIT) using stored customer tokens.
dependencies.investigation_required: Ensure mandate agreement flags are stored for recurring merchant-initiated transactions.

risks.title: Checkout Abandonment on 3DS Friction
risks.description: Customers unable to receive banking SMS OTP during checkout abandon shopping carts.
risks.mitigation: Implement frictionless flow optimizations, clear in-line instructions, and alternative payment method fallbacks (Apple Pay / Google Pay).

stakeholders.impact_reason: Mandatory certification of PCI SAQ-A compliance posture and token vault architecture.
Settlement batch reports, dispute/chargeback liability shift, and merchant fee reconciliation.

regression_areas.reason: Ensure guest users who choose NOT to save cards can still complete seamless transactions.
Verify off-session renewals succeed without requiring user interaction.

documentation_impacts.impact_description: Formal audit document confirming card data boundary isolation.

open_questions.question: How should the system handle off-session subscription renewals when a customer card requires interactive 3DS authentication?

Map out 3DS2 frictionless vs challenge flow state machine

Build webhook listener with signature verification and replay prevention
